status: current_specification; comparable time and complete declared money inputs are required
weight_mapping_basis: User-approved time-versus-money experiment design; not a claim that the transcript states these exact dimensions.
normalization: Min-max over the same complete hard-feasible candidate set across methods for one decision scenario.
hard_constraints: Exclude unreachable, invalid, illegal, or incomplete routes before scoring; economic incompleteness among feasible routes blocks the scenario score.

segment_accounting.energy: Retain signed EV v2 energy per ordered road Link and journey segment.
segment_accounting.electricity_billing: Sum signed Link net energy at the journey-segment boundary; bill max(segment_net_kWh, 0) times an explicit electricity rate.
segment_accounting.fare_attribution: Deadhead revenue is known zero. Record observed passenger fare once on the passenger segment; allocate per Link only under an explicit per-kilometre fare schedule.
segment_accounting.net_cost: Sum priced costs in the declared scope minus known segment fare revenue.
segment_accounting.api_compute: Store measured usage and matching rates once at method level, separate from route segments; add the method cost once to each alternative method-route score, never to Links or as an aggregate across alternatives.
segment_accounting.unknown_value_policy: Keep unknown fare, tariff, usage, and rate as null. Block net-cost scoring when required inputs for the declared scope are missing or incomparable.
segment_accounting.scope_policy: The default selection scope includes priced journey-segment electricity minus known passenger fare, plus measured API/token and compute expense once per method-route alternative. Missing components block the shared score. This is still not full fleet profitability.

candidate_pool_scope: Union of all hard-feasible route candidates from every method for the same task/scenario; the same pool is used by both profiles.
candidate_pool_completeness: If any hard-feasible candidate lacks comparable route time or any required declared monetary input, block both profiles for the whole scenario; do not rank the remaining subset.
declared_money_cost_components: measured API/token cost and matching rate
measured compute cost and matching rate

meeting_transcript_context.existing_project_interpretation: Distance-based fare revenue was discussed against electricity and token/API expense; the weight pairs in that passage were not unambiguously time-versus-money weights.
meeting_transcript_context.fare_rate_status: Illustrative only; not a frozen tariff or default.

reporting_limits: A single feasible candidate cannot establish a weight-driven route-choice change.
Full profitability is not established without depreciation, maintenance, insurance, tolls, taxes, and all other in-scope costs.
Energy is simulated unless supported by vehicle telemetry.
compatibility_note: v3 and v4 outputs remain historical sidecars; v5 preserves the shared candidate pool and adds signed-fare handling plus explicit null reasons.
signed_fare_policy: Accept any finite observed passenger fare, including negative values; preserve source sign and flag meaning for audit. Do not clamp or infer refund semantics.
amount_provenance_policy: Each journey segment records currency, price/fare source basis, and null_reasons for unavailable segment amounts; method-level API/compute null reasons stay with method_costs.
